items.source: Not all Spring applications have to be web applications (or web services). If you want to execute some code in a main method but also bootstrap a Spring application to set up the infrastructure to use, you can use the SpringApplication features of Spring Boot. A SpringApplication changes its ApplicationContext class, depending on whether it thinks it needs a web application or not. The first thing you can do to help it is to leave server-related dependencies (such as the servlet API) off the classpath. If you cannot do that (for example, if you run two applications from the same code base) then you can explicitly call setWebApplicationType(WebApplicationType.NONE) on your SpringApplication instance or set the applicationContextClass property (through the Java API or with external properties). Application code that you want to run as your business logic can be implemented as a CommandLineRunner and dropped into the context as a @Bean definition.
items.translation: 并非所有的 Spring 应用程序都必须是 Web 应用程序（或 Web 服务）。 如果您希望在 main 方法中执行一些代码，同时引导一个 Spring 应用程序以设置所需的基础设施，您可以使用 Spring Boot 的 SpringApplication 功能。 SpringApplication 会根据其判断是否需要 Web 应用程序，来改变其 ApplicationContext 类。 您可以做的第一件事是，将服务器相关的依赖项（例如 Servlet API）从类路径中移除。 如果您无法做到这一点（例如，您从同一个代码库运行两个应用程序），则可以在您的 SpringApplication 实例上显式调用 setWebApplicationType(WebApplicationType.NONE)，或者设置 applicationContextClass 属性（通过 Java API 或使用外部属性）。 您希望作为业务逻辑运行的应用程序代码可以实现为 CommandLineRunner，并作为 @Bean 定义放入上下文中。

items.source: Look for classes that are @ConfigurationProperties (such as ServerProperties) and read from there the available external configuration options. The @ConfigurationProperties annotation has a name attribute that acts as a prefix to external properties. Thus, ServerProperties has prefix="server" and its configuration properties are server.port, server.address, and others. In a running application with actuator enabled, look at the configprops endpoint.
items.translation: 查找带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类（例如 ServerProperties），并从该类中读取可用的外部配置选项。 @ConfigurationProperties 注解具有一个 name` 属性，该属性作为外部属性的前缀。 因此，ServerProperties 具有 `prefix="server"`，其配置属性为 `server.port`、`server.address` 等。 在启用了 actuator 的正在运行的应用程序中，查看 `configprops 端点。

items.source: There is a really useful ConditionEvaluationReport available in any Spring Boot ApplicationContext. You can see it if you enable DEBUG logging output. If you use the spring-boot-actuator (see the Actuator section), there is also a conditions endpoint that renders the report in JSON. Use that endpoint to debug the application and see what features have been added (and which have not been added) by Spring Boot at runtime.
items.translation: 有一个非常实用的 ConditionEvaluationReport 存在于任何 Spring Boot ApplicationContext 中。 如果您启用 DEBUG` 日志输出，就可以查看它。 如果您使用 `spring-boot-actuator`（参见 Actuator 部分），还有一个 `conditions 端点以 JSON 格式渲染该报告。 使用该端点来调试应用程序，查看 Spring Boot 在运行时添加了哪些功能（以及未添加哪些功能）。

items.source: A SpringApplication has ApplicationListener and ApplicationContextInitializer implementations that are used to apply customizations to the context or environment. Spring Boot loads a number of such customizations for use internally from META-INF/spring.factories. There is more than one way to register additional customizations:
items.translation: SpringApplication 包含 ApplicationListener 和 ApplicationContextInitializer 实现，用于对上下文或环境应用自定义配置。 Spring Boot 会从 META-INF/spring.factories 加载多种此类自定义配置以供内部使用。 注册额外自定义配置的方法不止一种：

items.source: The SpringApplication sends some special ApplicationEvents to the listeners (some even before the context is created) and then registers the listeners for events published by the ApplicationContext as well. See Application Events and Listeners in the “Spring Boot Features” section for a complete list.
items.translation: SpringApplication 会向监听器发送一些特殊的 ApplicationEvents（甚至在上下文创建之前），然后还会注册用于接收由 ApplicationContext 发布的事件的监听器。 请参阅“Spring Boot 功能”部分中的 Application Events and Listeners 以获取完整列表。

items.source: Look for classes called *AutoConfiguration and read their sources. Pay special attention to the @Conditional* annotations to find out what features they enable and when. Add --debug to the command line or the System property -Ddebug to get a log on the console of all the auto-configuration decisions that were made in your app. In a running application with actuator enabled, look at the conditions endpoint (/actuator/conditions or the JMX equivalent) for the same information.
items.translation: 查找名为 *AutoConfiguration` 的类并阅读其源代码。 特别注意 `@Conditional*` 注解，以了解它们启用了哪些功能以及何时启用。 在命令行中添加 `--debug，或在系统属性中添加 `-Ddebug`，以便在控制台上记录应用程序中所有自动配置决策的日志。 对于已启用 actuator 的运行中应用程序，查看 `conditions` 端点（`/actuator/conditions 或等价的 JMX 端点）以获取相同的信息。

items.source: AbstractFailureAnalyzer is a convenient extension of FailureAnalyzer that checks the presence of a specified exception type in the exception to handle. You can extend from that so that your implementation gets a chance to handle the exception only when it is actually present. If, for whatever reason, you cannot handle the exception, return null to give another implementation a chance to handle the exception.
items.translation: AbstractFailureAnalyzer 是 FailureAnalyzer 的一个便捷扩展，它会检查要处理的异常中是否存在指定的异常类型。您可以继承该类，以便您的实现仅在异常确实存在时才获得处理该异常的机会。如果由于某种原因您无法处理该异常，请返回 null，以让另一个实现有机会处理该异常。

items.source: Look for uses of the bind method on the Binder to pull configuration values explicitly out of the Environment in a relaxed manner. It is often used with a prefix.
items.translation: 查找对 Binder 的 bind 方法的使用，以轻松地从 Environment 中显式提取配置值。它通常与一个前缀一起使用。

items.source: You can use the SpringApplicationBuilder class to create parent/child ApplicationContext hierarchies. See Fluent Builder API in the “Spring Boot Features” section for more information.
items.translation: 您可以使用SpringApplicationBuilder类来创建父/子ApplicationContext层次结构。有关更多信息，请参阅“Spring Boot 功能”部分中的Fluent Builder API。

items.source: FailureAnalyzer is a great way to intercept an exception on startup and turn it into a human-readable message, wrapped in a FailureAnalysis. Spring Boot provides such an analyzer for application-context-related exceptions, JSR-303 validations, and more. You can also create your own.
items.translation: FailureAnalyzer 是拦截启动时的异常并将其转换为用 FailureAnalysis 包装的可读消息的绝佳方式。 Spring Boot 为与应用程序上下文相关的异常、JSR-303 验证等提供了此类分析器。 您也可以创建自己的分析器。

items.translation: FailureAnalyzer 实现必须在 META-INF/spring.factories 中注册。 以下示例注册了 ProjectConstraintViolationFailureAnalyzer：

items.source: Look for @Value annotations that bind directly to the Environment.
items.translation: 查找直接绑定到Environment的@Value注解。

items.source: Look for @ConditionalOnExpression annotations that switch features on and off in response to SpEL expressions, normally evaluated with placeholders resolved from the Environment.
items.translation: 查找 @ConditionalOnExpression 注解，这些注解会根据 SpEL 表达式开启或关闭功能，这些表达式通常使用从 Environment 解析的占位符进行求值。

items.source: Programmatically, per application, by calling the addListeners and addInitializers methods on SpringApplication before you run it.
items.translation: 程序上，在运行应用程序之前，通过调用 SpringApplication 上的 addListeners 和 addInitializers 方法，按应用程序进行配置。

items.translation: 声明式地，为所有应用程序添加一个 `<code>META-INF/spring.factories` 并打包一个所有应用程序都作为库使用的 jar 文件。

items.source: While using @PropertySource on your @SpringBootApplication may seem to be a convenient way to load a custom resource in the Environment, we do not recommend it. Such property sources are not added to the Environment until the application context is being refreshed. This is too late to configure certain properties such as logging.* and spring.main.* which are read before refresh begins.
items.translation: 在您的 @SpringBootApplication 上使用 @PropertySource 似乎是一种在 Environment 中加载自定义资源的便捷方法，但我们不建议这样做。 此类属性源直到应用程序上下文刷新时才会添加到 Environment 中。 这太晚了，无法配置某些属性，例如 logging.* 和 spring.main.*，这些属性在刷新开始之前就会被读取。

items.source: If you need access to the BeanFactory or the Environment, declare them as constructor arguments in your FailureAnalyzer implementation.
items.translation: 如果您需要访问 BeanFactory 或 Environment，请在您的 FailureAnalyzer 实现中将其声明为构造函数参数。

items.source: The Environment has already been prepared with all the usual property sources that Spring Boot loads by default. It is therefore possible to get the location of the file from the environment. The preceding example adds the custom-resource property source at the end of the list so that a key defined in any of the usual other locations takes precedence. A custom implementation may define another order.
items.translation: Environment 已经通过 Spring Boot 默认加载的所有常规属性源进行了准备。 因此，可以从环境中获取文件的位置。 前面的示例在列表末尾添加了 custom-resource 属性源，以便任何常规其他位置定义的键都具有优先权。 自定义实现可以定义另一个顺序。
